item.title: Using rclone (cloning database tables)
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
Rclone Quick Reference

I finally had to bite the bullet and install rclone, I might use it quite a lot. Essentially, I was trying to transfer some large files off my (productive) Debian Trixie machine onto my (productivity killer) Work Issues Windows Laptop. It turns out you can’t upload large files using OneDrive, so here we go. rclone.
